method: rotating drum, 16 mm diameter, 2.55 mm periodic slice, 20 rpm (Froude 0.0036)
notes: Angle = slope of a line fitted to the top of the bed over the central 60 % of the drum width, per 0.02 s dump, averaged over the window. Rough wall: frozen 0.3 mm spheres rotated with fix move rotate. Non-cohesive run only unless a "coh" entry is present (cohesive run was optional).
